title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.48: The Planned resolvers now play at most 10 Planned cards instead of all - Workshop, Showtime, Da Capo and Intermission play the first 10 in order; Remix plays 10 random ones in random order (Spectacle's Tuned play-all is unchanged). Pass the Mic is now exactly Best of Both aimed at an ally: Swap and Invert reduced by 1 each (now 1/1, upgrading to 2/2).
